# SASTABAZARONLINE

> SASTABAZARONLINE is an online shopping website operated by ADHYEY BROTHERS in India.

## Website
- Home: https://www.sastabazaronline.in/
- Products and categories are available through the storefront navigation and search.

## Shopping
- Customers can browse products, view product details, add items to cart, and proceed through checkout.
- Product price, availability, shipping eligibility, and applicable charges should be taken from the live product and checkout pages.

## Customer information
- Customers should use the website's published policy pages for current cancellation, return, refund, shipping, privacy, and other applicable terms.

## Crawling guidance
- Public storefront pages may be discovered and summarized by search engines and AI agents subject to robots.txt and applicable website policies.
- Do not treat admin, authentication, account, checkout, or other private/user-specific pages as public information.

## Canonical domain
https://www.sastabazaronline.in/
